name: anonymous-collab-website

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),{execSync}=require('child_process');if(fs.existsSync('frontend')){execSync('cd frontend && npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'});}else{execSync('npx vite build',{stdio:'inherit'});}"

description: Anonymous collaborative workspace with real-time editing, chat, whiteboard, and code execution.
